items.body_excerpt:
I still subsidize every script filled at cost plus.  We are getting closer to break even.  Not there yet. 

And I’m all for Universal Care.  What I’m against is thinking it will automagically work if M4A legislation is passed.  

We should be challenging pols to provide a plan.
